name: Duty
source:
A fantasy Game that is based on the MBTI personality test, where players find out their type through navigating the story.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=21564&p=274315]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
